name: Blacked
summary: The pioneering Vixen Media Group studio that brought luxury fashion photography, slow-burn buildup, and 4K cinema polish to interracial adult video.
ranking_rationale: Transformed studio production standards with immaculate 4K visuals and marquee performer debuts; specialized focus and premium pricing mean Vixen Plus is usually the smarter buy.

pricing.notes: Varies by plan and promo; standalone or included in Vixen Plus network bundle. Check official checkout.

pros: Industry-leading 4K lighting, framing, and set design
Frequent high-profile showcase scenes with A-list performers
Ad-free, modern streaming interface with full downloads
cons: Premium standalone pricing—better value inside Vixen Plus
Fewer monthly releases than megastudio networks

facts.value: Launched 2014; operated by Vixen Media Group
